senses.simple: All things; each thing.

examples.en: I packed everything I need for the sleepover.
examples.ko: 파자마 파티에 필요한 건 다 쌌다.

examples.en: Thank you for everything, Grandpa!

senses.simple: In or to all places.

examples.en: I looked everywhere for my cat.
examples.ko: 고양이를 찾느라 온 데를 다 뒤졌다.

examples.en: After the party, there was confetti everywhere.
examples.ko: 파티가 끝나고 나니 사방에 색종이 조각이 있었다.

senses.simple: Not any person; nobody. Also written "no-one".

examples.en: No one was at the playground because it was raining.
No one knows where the hamster went.

senses.simple: Not any person; no one.

examples.en: Nobody answered the phone.
Nobody likes to be left out.
examples.ko: 따돌림받는 걸 좋아하는 사람은 아무도 없다.

senses.simple: Not anything; no thing at all.

examples.en: There is nothing in the fridge except milk.
I said nothing because I was too shy.
examples.ko: 너무 부끄러워서 아무 말도 하지 않았다.

senses.simple: Not in or to any place.

examples.en: My lost glove was nowhere to be found.
examples.ko: 잃어버린 장갑은 어디서도 찾을 수 없었다.

examples.en: We are going nowhere until you clean your room.
examples.ko: 네 방을 치우기 전에는 아무 데도 안 갈 거야.

senses.simple: The whole amount, or every one of a group.

examples.en: All the kids in my class like recess.
examples.ko: 우리 반 아이들은 모두 쉬는 시간을 좋아한다.

examples.en: Who ate all the popcorn?

senses.simple: Completely; very.

examples.en: My shoes got all muddy at the park.
I was all alone in the house.

senses.simple: Some, or even a little, often in questions and "not" sentences.

examples.en: Do you have any snacks?
There isn't any milk left.

senses.simple: One or some, it does not matter which.

examples.en: Pick any card from the deck.
You can come over any day this week.
examples.ko: 이번 주 아무 날이나 놀러 와도 돼.

senses.simple: The two; this one and that one too.
senses.ko_simple: 두 개 모두, 두 사람 모두

examples.en: Both of my grandmas live in Korea.
examples.ko: 우리 할머니 두 분 다 한국에 사신다.

examples.en: Hold the cup with both hands.

senses.simple: Every one of a group, thought of one at a time.

examples.en: Each student gets a turn to read aloud.
examples.ko: 학생 한 명 한 명 모두 소리 내어 읽을 차례가 있다.

examples.en: The cupcakes cost two dollars each.

senses.simple: One or the other of two.

examples.en: You can have either the red one or the blue one.
examples.ko: 빨간 것이나 파란 것 중 하나를 가져도 돼.

examples.en: There are trees on either side of the road.

senses.simple: Also; too. Used in "not" sentences.

examples.en: I don't like spinach, and my brother doesn't either.
"I can't swim." "I can't either."

senses.simple: Not one and not the other of two.
senses.ko_simple: 둘 중에 어느 것도 아니라는 뜻

examples.en: Neither of my parents likes scary movies.
examples.ko: 우리 부모님 두 분 다 무서운 영화를 싫어하신다.

examples.en: Neither answer is right. Try again!
examples.ko: 두 답 다 틀렸어. 다시 해 봐!

senses.simple: Also not.

examples.en: "I'm not hungry." "Neither am I."
He didn't laugh, and neither did she.
examples.ko: 그도 웃지 않았고 그녀도 웃지 않았다.

senses.simple: All of a group, with no one left out.

examples.en: Every student got a gold star today.
examples.ko: 오늘 모든 학생이 금색 별을 받았다.

examples.en: I brush my teeth every morning and every night.
examples.ko: 나는 매일 아침과 밤에 이를 닦는다.

senses.simple: "A few" means some, a small number.

examples.en: I have a few friends coming over today.
examples.ko: 오늘 친구 몇 명이 놀러 온다.

examples.en: Wait a few minutes, and the cookies will be ready.
examples.ko: 몇 분만 기다리면 쿠키가 다 구워질 거야.

senses.simple: "Few" with no "a" means not many, almost none.

examples.en: Few people go to the beach in winter.
examples.ko: 겨울에는 바다에 가는 사람이 거의 없다.

examples.en: Very few animals can live in the hot desert.
examples.ko: 뜨거운 사막에서 살 수 있는 동물은 아주 적다.

senses.simple: A large number of. Used with things you can count.
senses.ko_simple: 셀 수 있는 것이 많다는 뜻

examples.en: There are many stars in the sky tonight.
How many cookies did you eat?

senses.simple: A large amount of. Used with things you cannot count, like water or time.
senses.ko_simple: 물이나 시간처럼 셀 수 없는 것이 많다는 뜻

examples.en: We don't have much time before the bus comes.
examples.ko: 버스가 오기 전까지 시간이 많지 않다.

examples.en: How much money do you have in your piggy bank?

senses.simple: A lot; very.

examples.en: Thank you very much for the gift!
I feel much better after my nap.

senses.simple: A bigger number or amount.

examples.en: Can I have more pancakes, please?
Our class read more books than any other class.
examples.ko: 우리 반은 다른 어느 반보다 책을 더 많이 읽었다.

senses.simple: Used before some describing words to mean "to a greater amount", as in "more beautiful".
senses.ko_simple: 꾸며 주는 말 앞에 붙어 '더 ~한'이라는 뜻

examples.en: This puzzle is more difficult than the last one.
examples.ko: 이 퍼즐은 지난번 것보다 더 어렵다.

examples.en: Please speak more slowly.

senses.simple: The biggest number or amount; almost all.

examples.en: Most kids in my class walk to school.
examples.ko: 우리 반 아이들 대부분은 걸어서 학교에 온다.

examples.en: Who scored the most points in the game?
examples.ko: 경기에서 누가 가장 많은 점수를 냈어?

senses.simple: Used before some describing words to mean "more than all others", as in "most beautiful".
senses.ko_simple: 꾸며 주는 말 앞에 붙어 '가장 ~한'이라는 뜻

examples.en: This is the most exciting book I have ever read.
examples.ko: 이건 내가 읽은 책 중에 가장 신나는 책이다.

examples.en: That was the most beautiful sunset I have ever seen.
examples.ko: 그건 내가 본 노을 중 가장 아름다운 노을이었다.

senses.simple: Different from the one already talked about; the rest.
senses.ko_simple: 앞에서 말한 것과 다른, 또는 나머지

examples.en: I found one sock, but where is the other one?
examples.ko: 양말 한 짝은 찾았는데 다른 한 짝은 어디 있지?

examples.en: Some kids like soccer, and other kids like basketball.
examples.ko: 축구를 좋아하는 아이도 있고 농구를 좋아하는 아이도 있다.

senses.simple: One more.

examples.en: Can I have another slice of pizza?
examples.ko: 피자 한 조각 더 먹어도 돼?

examples.en: Let's read another chapter before bed.
examples.ko: 자기 전에 한 장 더 읽자.

senses.simple: A different one.

examples.en: This crayon is broken. Can I use another one?
examples.ko: 이 크레용 부러졌어. 다른 거 써도 돼?

examples.en: We will finish the game another day.

senses.simple: A number or amount of something, but not all and not an exact amount.

examples.en: Would you like some juice?
Some of my friends are coming to the movie.
examples.ko: 친구 몇 명이 영화 보러 온다.

senses.simple: A person or thing you do not know or do not name.

examples.en: Some man called and asked for Dad.
I read about it in some book at the library.

senses.simple: So much; very great. Used to make a feeling stronger.

examples.en: It was such a hot day that we stayed in the pool.
examples.ko: 정말 더운 날이라서 우리는 수영장에만 있었다.

examples.en: You are such a good friend!

senses.simple: Of this kind; like this. "Such as" means "for example".

examples.en: I like fruits such as apples and grapes.
examples.ko: 나는 사과나 포도 같은 과일을 좋아한다.

examples.en: I have never seen such a big pumpkin before.

senses.simple: More than two, but not very many.

examples.en: I have read that book several times.
examples.ko: 나는 그 책을 여러 번 읽었다.

examples.en: Several birds are sitting on the fence.
examples.ko: 새 몇 마리가 울타리에 앉아 있다.

senses.simple: As much or as many as you need.

examples.en: Do we have enough chairs for everyone?
I've had enough to eat, thank you.

senses.simple: To the amount needed. It comes after the describing word, as in "big enough".
senses.ko_simple: 꾸며 주는 말 뒤에 와서 '충분히 ~한'이라는 뜻

examples.en: I am tall enough to ride the roller coaster now!
examples.ko: 이제 나는 롤러코스터를 탈 만큼 키가 커!

examples.en: The water is not warm enough for swimming.

senses.simple: The number 1.

examples.en: I have one brother and two sisters.
examples.ko: 나는 남자 형제 한 명과 여자 형제 두 명이 있다.

examples.en: One plus one is two.

senses.simple: Used instead of saying a thing again.
senses.ko_simple: 앞에 나온 물건을 다시 말하지 않고 대신 쓰는 말

examples.en: I don't like this hat. Can I try the red one?
examples.ko: 이 모자는 마음에 안 들어. 빨간 거 써 봐도 돼?

examples.en: My pencil broke, so I need a new one.

senses.simple: The number 2.

examples.en: A bike has two wheels.
I'll be ready in two minutes.

senses.simple: The number 3.

examples.en: A triangle has three sides.
The story of the three little pigs is my favorite.
examples.ko: 아기 돼지 삼 형제 이야기를 제일 좋아한다.

senses.simple: The number 4.

examples.en: A dog has four legs.
There are four seasons in a year.

senses.simple: The number 5.

examples.en: I have five fingers on each hand.
examples.ko: 나는 한 손에 손가락이 다섯 개 있다.

examples.en: Give me five!

senses.simple: The number 6.

examples.en: An insect has six legs.
I wake up at six o'clock on school days.

senses.simple: The number 7.

examples.en: There are seven days in a week.
A rainbow has seven colors.

senses.simple: The number 8.

examples.en: An octopus has eight arms.
A spider has eight legs, not six.
examples.ko: 거미는 다리가 여섯 개가 아니라 여덟 개다.

senses.simple: The number 9.

examples.en: I am nine years old.
A baseball game usually has nine innings.

senses.simple: The number 10.

examples.en: I can count to ten in Korean.
examples.ko: 나는 한국어로 열까지 셀 수 있다.

examples.en: Most people have ten toes.

senses.simple: Coming before all others in order or time; number one.

examples.en: I was the first one in line for lunch.
Today is the first day of summer vacation!

senses.simple: Before anything else.

examples.en: First, wash your hands. Then we can eat.
examples.ko: 먼저 손을 씻어. 그러고 나서 먹자.

examples.en: Who wants to go first?

senses.simple: Coming right after the first one; number two.

examples.en: My classroom is on the second floor.
She came in second in the spelling bee.

senses.simple: A very short amount of time. There are 60 seconds in a minute.

examples.en: Hold your breath for ten seconds.
Wait a second! I forgot my backpack.

senses.simple: Coming after all the others; at the end.

examples.en: Z is the last letter of the alphabet.
Who wants the last piece of cake?

senses.simple: The one just before now.

examples.en: We went to the beach last summer.
I had a funny dream last night.

senses.simple: To keep going for a period of time.

examples.en: The movie lasted for two hours.
These batteries will last a long time.

senses.simple: Coming right after this one.

examples.en: Next week is spring break!
Who is next in line?

senses.simple: Right after this; then.

examples.en: What should we do next?
First, mix the flour. Next, add the eggs.
examples.ko: 먼저 밀가루를 섞어. 다음에 달걀을 넣어.

senses.simple: "Next to" means right beside.

examples.en: Sit next to me on the bus.
The library is next to the school.

senses.simple: A word that joins words or parts of a sentence together.
senses.ko_simple: 말과 말, 문장과 문장을 이어 주는 말

examples.en: I like peanut butter and jelly sandwiches.
We went to the park, and then we got ice cream.
examples.ko: 우리는 공원에 갔고 그다음에 아이스크림을 먹었다.

senses.simple: Used to add numbers, like "plus".

examples.en: Two and two make four.
Three and five is eight.

senses.simple: A word you use to show a choice between things.
senses.ko_simple: 여러 가지 중에서 고를 때 쓰는 말

examples.en: Do you want milk or juice?
We can play tag or hide-and-seek.

senses.simple: Used to say what will happen if you do not do something.

examples.en: Hurry up, or we will miss the bus!
Wear your coat, or you will get cold.
examples.ko: 코트를 입어, 안 그러면 추울 거야.

senses.simple: A word you use to join two ideas that are different or surprising together.
senses.ko_simple: 서로 반대되는 두 생각을 이어 주는 말

examples.en: I wanted to play outside, but it was raining.
examples.ko: 밖에서 놀고 싶었지만 비가 오고 있었다.

examples.en: The puppy is small but very loud.

senses.simple: Except; other than.

examples.en: Everyone but Jake came to the party.
There was nothing but crumbs left on the plate.
examples.ko: 접시에는 부스러기 말고는 아무것도 남지 않았다.

senses.simple: A word that tells what happens because of something.
senses.ko_simple: 앞의 일 때문에 뒤의 일이 생겼다는 것을 이어 주는 말

examples.en: It was cold, so I wore my mittens.
I was hungry, so I made a sandwich.

senses.simple: Very; to a great amount.

examples.en: The puppy is so cute!
I am so tired after the soccer game.

senses.simple: "So that" tells the reason or goal for doing something.

examples.en: I studied hard so that I would pass the test.
Speak up so everyone can hear you.
examples.ko: 모두 들을 수 있게 크게 말해.

senses.simple: A word you use to give the reason for something.
senses.ko_simple: 어떤 일의 이유를 말할 때 쓰는 말

examples.en: I wore a hat because it was sunny.
We stayed inside because of the storm.

senses.simple: Used to talk about something that might happen, and what will happen then.
senses.ko_simple: 어떤 일이 일어난다면 어떻게 될지 말할 때 쓰는 말

examples.en: If it rains, we will watch a movie.
If you drop the egg, it will break.

senses.simple: Used to ask or wonder about yes-or-no things; whether.

examples.en: Can you ask Mom if I can stay up late?
examples.ko: 엄마한테 내가 늦게까지 안 자도 되는지 물어봐 줄래?

examples.en: I wonder if it will snow tomorrow.

senses.simple: If not; except if.

examples.en: We will go to the beach unless it rains.
examples.ko: 비가 오지 않으면 바다에 갈 거야.

examples.en: You can't have dessert unless you eat your vegetables.
examples.ko: 채소를 먹지 않으면 디저트를 먹을 수 없어.

senses.simple: Used to say that something is true even though something else might make you think it isn't.

examples.en: Although it was raining, we still played soccer.
examples.ko: 비가 오고 있었지만 우리는 그래도 축구를 했다.

examples.en: Although my dog is old, he still loves to run.
examples.ko: 우리 개는 나이가 많지만 여전히 뛰는 걸 좋아한다.

senses.simple: The same as "although": even if; in spite of the fact that.

examples.en: Though it was late, I wasn't sleepy.
I finished the race, even though I was very tired.

senses.simple: However. It often comes at the end of a sentence.

examples.en: The test was hard. I think I did well, though.
examples.ko: 시험이 어려웠어. 그래도 잘 본 것 같아.

examples.en: It's cold today. It's sunny, though.

senses.simple: During the time that something else is happening.

examples.en: I listen to music while I draw.
examples.ko: 나는 그림 그리는 동안 음악을 듣는다.

examples.en: Someone called while you were in the shower.

senses.simple: A period of time.

examples.en: Let's rest for a while before we hike more.
I haven't seen my cousin in a long while.

senses.simple: Used to show a difference between two things.
senses.ko_simple: 두 가지의 다른 점을 보여 줄 때 쓰는 말

examples.en: My sister loves cats, while I love dogs.
examples.ko: 언니는 고양이를 좋아하는 반면 나는 개를 좋아한다.

examples.en: Summer is hot, while winter is cold.

senses.simple: Used to show how two things are different.
senses.ko_simple: 두 가지가 어떻게 다른지 비교할 때 쓰는 말

examples.en: Frogs have smooth skin, whereas toads have bumpy skin.
examples.ko: 개구리는 피부가 매끈한 반면 두꺼비는 피부가 울퉁불퉁하다.

examples.en: I like to get up early, whereas my brother likes to sleep in.
examples.ko: 나는 일찍 일어나는 걸 좋아하는 반면 동생은 늦잠 자는 걸 좋아한다.

senses.simple: Used when there are two choices, like "if ... or not".
senses.ko_simple: 두 가지 중 어느 쪽인지, '~인지 아닌지'라는 뜻

examples.en: I can't decide whether to wear the red shirt or the blue one.
examples.ko: 빨간 셔츠를 입을지 파란 셔츠를 입을지 못 정하겠다.

examples.en: We will play outside whether it is sunny or cloudy.
examples.ko: 맑든 흐리든 우리는 밖에서 놀 거야.

senses.simple: Up to the time when.

examples.en: Stir the soup until it boils.
The library is open until 6 o'clock.

senses.simple: From a time in the past until now.

examples.en: I have lived here since I was three.
examples.ko: 나는 세 살 때부터 여기서 살았다.

examples.en: It has been raining since Monday.

senses.simple: Because.

examples.en: Since it's your birthday, you can choose dinner.
examples.ko: 네 생일이니까 저녁 메뉴는 네가 골라.

examples.en: Since we finished early, we can play a game.

senses.simple: A word you use when you compare two things.
senses.ko_simple: 두 가지를 비교할 때 쓰는 말

examples.en: An elephant is bigger than a horse.
I would rather read than watch TV.

senses.simple: "As ... as" is used to say two things are the same in some way.

examples.en: My brother is as tall as my dad now.
Run as fast as you can!
examples.ko: 할 수 있는 한 빨리 달려!

senses.simple: In the role of; dressed like.

examples.en: I dressed up as a pirate for Halloween.
My mom works as a teacher.

senses.simple: While; at the same time that. Also means "because".

examples.en: The crowd cheered as the runners crossed the finish line.
As it was late, we went home.

senses.simple: And not. Often used after "neither" or "not".

examples.en: Neither my mom nor my dad can sing well.
examples.ko: 엄마도 아빠도 노래를 잘 못 하신다.

examples.en: I don't like spiders, nor do I like snakes.

senses.simple: Until now; so far. Used in questions and "not" sentences.

examples.en: I haven't finished my homework yet.
Are we there yet?

senses.simple: But; even so.

examples.en: The test was hard, yet I got an A.
It's small, yet it's very strong.

senses.simple: On the subject of.

examples.en: This book is about a brave little mouse.
examples.ko: 이 책은 용감한 작은 생쥐에 관한 이야기다.

examples.en: We talked about our summer vacation.

senses.simple: Close to; a little more or less than.

examples.en: It takes about ten minutes to walk to school.
There were about fifty people at the party.

senses.simple: "About to" means going to happen very soon.

examples.en: The movie is about to start.
I was about to call you!

senses.simple: Higher than something; over it.

examples.en: A bird flew above our heads.
examples.ko: 새 한 마리가 우리 머리 위로 날아갔다.

examples.en: The picture hangs above the fireplace.
examples.ko: 그 그림은 벽난로 위에 걸려 있다.

senses.simple: More than a number or amount.

examples.en: The temperature was above 90 degrees today.
You need to score above 80 to win a prize.

senses.simple: From one side to the other side.

examples.en: We walked across the bridge.
The duck swam across the pond.

senses.simple: On the other side of.

examples.en: My best friend lives across the street.
examples.ko: 가장 친한 친구가 길 건너편에 산다.

examples.en: The bakery is across from the library.

senses.simple: Later than something.

examples.en: We can play video games after dinner.
examples.ko: 저녁 먹은 후에 비디오 게임을 해도 돼.

examples.en: After school, I go to taekwondo.

senses.simple: Following or chasing someone or something.

examples.en: The dog ran after the ball.
Please close the door after you.
examples.ko: 들어오고 나서 문 좀 닫아 줘.

senses.simple: Touching something and leaning on it.

examples.en: I leaned my bike against the wall.
Rain beat against the window all night.

senses.simple: Playing or fighting on the other side.

examples.en: Our team played against the Tigers.
It's us against the robots!

senses.simple: Not agreeing with something.

examples.en: Mom is against eating candy before dinner.
examples.ko: 엄마는 저녁 전에 사탕 먹는 걸 반대하신다.

examples.en: It is against the rules to run by the pool.
examples.ko: 수영장 옆에서 뛰는 것은 규칙 위반이다.
